# Objective

Apply the three verified sixth-round review findings as one fix batch,
keeping the suite green and the documented policies in sync.

# Verified findings (all reproduced before fixing)

1. The occurrence scan collected the complete hit list of a
   contig/probe before checking `--max-candidates-per-read` — 19,999
   placements allocated on a 20 kb poly-A contig with cap 10, violating
   the documented cap + 1 bound (P1, memory).
2. The cross-contig rescue path relocated primaries of templates with
   secondary records (relocation ran before any non-primary exclusion on
   that path), leaving the secondary pointing at an abandoned locus (P2,
   record consistency; same-contig path was already safe via merge-gate
   ordering).
3. FASTA contigs absent from the BAM header were skipped entirely, so an
   off-header duplicate copy was invisible to the uniqueness claim (P2,
   false uniqueness versus the whole-reference requirement).

# Changes as executed

- `src/pairloom/rescue.py`:
  - `_scan_contig` is a generator; `_global_occurrences` checks the cap
    after every occurrence and returns at cap + 1 — memory bounded
    regardless of reference repetitiveness, and the scan stops instead
    of finishing the contig.
  - `_contig_keys`: header contigs keep their BAM tid; off-header FASTA
    contigs get unique negative keys in reference order. Off-header
    occurrences count toward ambiguity and the cap; the rescue decision
    enumerates compatible pairs reference-wide, requires exactly one,
    and requires it placeable (a unique off-header-only pair reports
    `rescue_no_compatible_pair`, an off-header duplicate makes the pair
    `rescue_ambiguous`).
  - `rescue_eligible` gains `has_non_primary` — the exclusion now runs
    before any search or record mutation on every path.
- `src/pairloom/pipeline.py`: both rescue call sites pass
  `has_non_primary=bool(others)`.
- Tests (suite 172 → 176): bounded occurrence scan (`len == cap + 1`,
  20 kb poly-A), off-header duplicate → `rescue_ambiguous`, unique
  off-header-only pair → `rescue_no_compatible_pair`, cross-contig
  secondary → nothing relocated; chunked-scan test asserts the generator
  contract.
- README + AGENTS.md invariant 10 updated: whole-reference ambiguity
  scope, generator-bounded scan, before-search non-primary exclusion,
  test count.

# Verification

- `pixi run test`: 176 passed; `pixi run lint` / `pixi run format`:
  clean.
- All three reproductions re-run at the original sites show the fixed
  behavior (11 placements, originals kept with the secondary, duplicate
  unmerged).
- Rescue benchmark re-run (generator + contig-key mapping touch only the
  rescue path): see the report's observation for numbers.
